boundGoal.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann einfache Diagramme deuten, indem sie Auffälligkeiten anhand der dargestellten Daten beschreibt, Werte vergleicht und erste Trends in Worte fasst.
boundGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret simple diagrams by describing noticeable features using the displayed data, comparing values, and expressing initial trends in words.

visualInspection.method: Actual original-resolution local JPG opened with view_image and its full visible content independently inspected against exact B DE/EN meaning. No image generation or transformation. Both file byte hashes independently calculated.
visualInspection.judgment: appropriate instructional visualization for current B goal

observations.finding: The visitor axis starts at zero with 20/40/60/80 marks; the day axis is ordered Mo/Di/Mi/Do/Fr. The plotted values are 40/55/50/70/65 and the displayed subtraction explicitly identifies the first two values.
The speech bubble correctly identifies Thursday as the highest point. It points to the actual maximum, not an ungrounded visual guess.
Tuesday exceeds Monday by 15; 55−40=15 is numerically correct and the two arrows identify the intended observations.

Insgesamt eher steigend accurately summarizes the overall ordered-week pattern without claiming monotonic increase: Tuesday→Wednesday and Thursday→Friday decrease. No continuation, cause, regression or generalization is claimed.

Diagramme deuten, Besucher im Schwimmbad, day labels and German annotations are readable and correctly spelled, including Höchster. The points, axes and essential annotations remain distinguishable; no visible mathematical or textual artifact identified.

The existing black-and-white didactic line chart gives a bounded worked example of all three B actions. It is answer-bearing teaching material, not an unanswered assessment or evidence of mastery. It does not claim coverage of every diagram form; the numerical difference is an example, not a new universal computation requirement.

conditions: Fresh P tasks must require independent interpretation of a new unanswered diagram rather than copying these supplied interpretations.
Use trends only where an ordered variable justifies them; no general trend or causal obligation is added to all diagrams.
This AI review supplies no new human approval, release decision, license claim or empirical learning-effectiveness finding.
